gen-gf-paprika-gf-gidole: Paprika sprawls across the line, loud and loosely spaced. Gidole sits beneath in uniform, neon-tube strokes, and that gap between loose and tidy is what makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-golos-text: Paprika is all swagger, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Golos Text takes the opposite job: a tall x-height, uniform strokes, and a quiet knack for steady reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Widely scattered letters give Paprika a loud, commanding presence on the line. Hedvig Letters Sans can stay modest in size, since its small letters stand almost as tall as capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-heebo: Heebo brings a tall central band of text and curves that stop short of closing. And Paprika takes the stage with scattered, commanding letters while Heebo does the quieter talking.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai feels approachable and plain-spoken, its s curves flaring wide at both ends. But Paprika's scattered, commanding letters supply all the drama that the body deliberately leaves out.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-mysuru: Paprika stands loud and scattered, every letter held at a distance. Hind Mysuru carries extended text smoothly, its lowercase tops pressing near ascender height with no calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-inter-tight: Loud, loose and unmistakable: that is Paprika at the top. Paprika handles the drama, while Inter Tight handles the quiet work, its g drawn in one unchanging line weight.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-kedebideri: Paprika arrives scattered and commanding, with counters like a split reed. Kedebideri steps in with rounded, inviting letters and a skyward x-height, giving the page one loud voice and one welcoming one.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-krub: Krub carries a pronounced x-height, plus curves that lift off before closing. Against Paprika's scattered, commanding letters, that restraint becomes the whole charm: one shouts, the other simply talks.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-lexend: Lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals make Paprika hard to ignore. Lexend offers flat, contrast-free letterforms with open jaws on every curve, making the sharpest foil for Paprika.
